hints.title: Enumerate Rhombus Centers and Radii
hints.text: Iterate over all possible center cells (r, c) and radii k >= 0 that fit within grid boundaries.

hints.title: Perimeter Summation
hints.text: For radius k = 0, the sum is grid[r][c]; for k > 0, sum the 4 diagonal boundary segments of length k.

hints.title: Top Three Distinct Selection
hints.text: Insert all computed sums into a unique set, sort descending, and return at most the top three elements.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Grid size is at most 50x50, so iterating all rhombuses takes < 10^5 operations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Diagonal boundary evaluation collects unique sums in small memory, sorting top three in O(1) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate checks bounds for all 4 vertices (r-k, c), (r+k, c), (r, c-k), (r, c+k).
